name: Parties
description: Who takes part in a checkout. The merchant, the payment processor and the carrier are instances of one organization entity. This domain is that vocabulary. It is not any of the firms.

entities.name: Organization
entities.description: A firm. Juniper & Pine sells. Northwind Pay captures payment. Swift Parcel carries shipments. Same entity, three instances.

entities.name: Person
